responseText:
I don’t have the PDF—only the filename—so I can’t inspect or summarize it. To produce an accurate, document-specific summary I need you to provide the file contents. Options (pick one):

- Attach/upload the full Q4-results-final.pdf.
- Paste the text of the PDF (or key excerpts) into the chat.
- Upload screenshots or scanned images of the most important pages (cover, CEO/management summary, consolidated financial statements, cash‑flow, notes, auditor’s report, and any guidance slides).

If you can’t or won’t share the full file, at minimum please provide these pages or data fields:
- Cover / title page and date
- Management (CEO/CFO) highlights / MD&A
- Consolidated income statement (current quarter and comparable period)
- Balance sheet (period‑end)
- Cash flow statement (operating / investing / financing)
- Segment results (if any)
- Guidance or outlook and any material one‑time items
- Notes or auditor’s opinion for materially significant items

Tell me also:
- Desired summary length/format (e.g., 5‑bullet executive summary, 1‑page detailed summary, slide bullets).
- Audience and focus (investors, board, internal finance, press) and whether you want YoY and/or QoQ comparisons.
- Currency and any materiality threshold (e.g., flag items > 5% of revenue).

Once you provide the PDF or the requested extracts and choices above, I will inspect the document and produce a concise, evidence‑based summary with headline metrics and key takeaways.
